title: PLG→Sales Signals Pilot Cohort — Account List + Owner Mapping (Wave 1)
sheet_overview: Pilot cohort for PLG→sales intent signals (Wave 1). Goal: validate routing + playbook with a controlled set of self-serve accounts. This sheet is the source of truth for owner mapping, suppression flags, and CS notes. Update rules: (1) Sales Ops owns AE assignment + geo rules; (2) CS owns suppression for managed enterprise accounts; (3) SDR owner (Grace) owns sequence enrollment + outcomes logging; (4) Any opt-out/DNC overrides everything.
